senses.zh_definition: 佩蒂格鲁：英语姓氏；在《哈利·波特》语境中，可指彼得·佩蒂格鲁。具体所指取决于上下文。
senses.en_definition: A surname; in Harry Potter contexts, the surname of the fictional character Peter Pettigrew.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris; dalam konteks Harry Potter, nama keluarga watak Peter Pettigrew.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，规范形式为 Pettigrew。仅凭输入不能认定它一定指《哈利·波特》角色；以下文学例句明确采用该语境。此处马来语释义为编辑释义，status 字段不代表 DBP 收录认证。角色身份见 [官方角色介绍](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/peter-pettigrew)。以下为自然名称组合，不宣称其语料频率。

etymology.historical_story: Pettigrew is a Scottish and English surname of Norman origin. The Dictionary of American Family Names cautiously connects it with Anglo-Norman words meaning little and growth, probably a nickname for a small man. This historical explanation concerns the surname, not the personality of every bearer or Rowling’s reasons for choosing it. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/pettigrew)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 PET-ti-grew 三拍记住读音，再联想到彼得·佩蒂格鲁；这是人物联想，不把 pet 或 grew 当作真实词根。
